summary.text: An SEO toolkit tested by SelectVerdict on the Free+ plan through KWFinder, SERPChecker, SERPWatcher, SiteProfiler, and LinkMiner.

keyFeatures.text: KWFinder imported and exported all 25 frozen keywords in one batch.
SERPChecker produced one full top-10 export and two partial exports before the observed daily allowance was exhausted.
SiteProfiler and LinkMiner returned results for all four frozen domains.

pros.text: The full 25-keyword batch was accepted and exported to CSV.
All four frozen domains were covered by SiteProfiler and LinkMiner.

cons.text: The observed SERP allowance was exhausted before all six fixed queries could be completed.
SERPWatcher returned no rank values during the final verification poll.

bestFor.text: Users who value the observed batch keyword workflow and can work within plan-specific quotas and result timing.

notFor.text: A one-session benchmark requiring six deep SERPs and immediate rank output on the observed Free+ limits.

sources.title: SelectVerdict Phase 1A Mangools hands-on results
sources.supports: Observed Free+ limits, frozen test outputs, missing data, workflow, cost, and verification gate.

verdict.summary: The observed Free+ run completed keyword, domain, and backlink coverage, but SERP quota and delayed ranks constrained same-session evidence.
verdict.basis: A frozen 25-keyword, six-SERP, four-domain hands-on run completed on 2026-09-21.
